tests.reason: Provisional proxy checks allowed calculation, but stricter actual triangle interior verification later rejected S1. Retain S5 controls as exploratory evidence only; not formal acceptance.
tests.selection_rule: Actual pass first, then smallest maximum violation of predeclared gates; no new optimization or tolerance change

limitations: Static only, no force/soft tissue simulation
Near contact area is geometric tolerance area
Source animation datablocks may remain as inherited references; experimental scenes have no bound object animations
S5 was started only after all S1-S4 met provisional proxy checks; final actual checks reported explicitly

metric_definitions.contact_distance: Minimum true pulp-to-current top-surface distance, zero when the actual clipped skin triangle touches/crosses the playable top surface
metric_definitions.signed_vertical_gap: Minimum signed pulp height over playable top polygons; negative does not itself define 3D solid-depth
metric_definitions.intrusion_depth: Maximum minimum-normal distance inside each actual convex key piece, considering vertices and exact triangle interior extrema
metric_definitions.contact_area: Projected skin surface area in a ±0.05mm slab, not actual soft-tissue/force-bearing area
metric_definitions.self_collision: BVH intersection of confident semantic digit triangles after excluding original topology-neighbor/shared-vertex pairs
metric_definitions.self_depth: Not inferred from intersection counts; null where not separately computed
metric_definitions.minimum_skin_gap: Sampled vertex-to-BVH-triangle gap; not a continuous-motion or exhaustive edge-edge certificate
